$comment: Services the owner can connect themselves, as official remote MCP servers that any app may sign in to (OAuth with dynamic client registration) or that take a key. Read by scripts/tools.py; the dashboard's Connections page shows them. Add one by adding an entry: its vendor's MCP address and how it signs in. Services that need an app registered by hand (Slack, HubSpot, Asana, Zoom, Google) aren't here: connect them as connectors at claude.ai, or use Steerable Cloud.
